plugins.description: 68 PM skills (30 phase + 11 foundation + 12 utility + 15 tool) plus 6 sub-agents (pm-critic, pm-skill-auditor, pm-changelog-curator, pm-release-conductor, pm-workflow-orchestrator, pm-skill-router) covering the full product lifecycle. v2.35.1 is a documentation patch: the README and the docs-site homepage now state what the tests found about the skills, including where a skill adds nothing, and the evals reference page summarizes every no-skill comparison to date. No skill changes; catalog stays 68 skills / 6 sub-agents. Full release history: https://github.com/product-on-purpose/pm-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
